title: Silas and the Static
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Jonah Zhou, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
